bns85.sources: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita §85; Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita §86
elements: the accused is the husband, or a relative of the husband, of the woman
subjects the woman to cruelty (s.86(a) or (b))

bns46_instigation.sources: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita §45; Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita §46
elements: instigates any person to do the thing (urges, incites or provokes it), including, per s.45 Explanation 1, wilfully misrepresenting or wilfully concealing a material fact one is bound to disclose so as to cause, procure, or attempt to cause or procure it

the thing abetted is itself an offence, or is an act which would be an offence if committed by a person capable by law of committing an offence with the same intention or knowledge as the abettor's own

bns46_conspiracy.sources: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita §45; Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita §46
elements: engages with one or more other persons in a conspiracy for the doing of the thing, and an act or illegal omission takes place in pursuance of that conspiracy and in order to the doing of the thing (no concert with the person who actually does it is required -- s.46 Explanation 5)

the thing abetted is itself an offence, or is an act which would be an offence if committed by a person capable by law of committing an offence with the same intention or knowledge as the abettor's own

bns46_intentional_aid.sources: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita §45; Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita §46
elements: intentionally aids, by any act or illegal omission, the doing of the thing, including, per s.45 Explanation 2, doing anything prior to or at the time of the act in order to facilitate it and thereby facilitating it

the thing abetted is itself an offence, or is an act which would be an offence if committed by a person capable by law of committing an offence with the same intention or knowledge as the abettor's own
